mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user(username, password, email, authority) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{authority})
INSERT INTO client(cno, cname, csex, cage, caddress, cphone, cdate, cremark, uid) VALUES (#{cno}, #{cname}, #{csex}, #{cage}, #{caddress}, #{cphone}, #{cdate}, #{cremark}, #{uid})
mapper.select:
SELECT user.uid, username, authority, cno, email, cname, csex, cage, caddress, cphone, cdate, cremark, balance FROM user, client
user.uid = client.uid
and CAST(user.uid AS CHAR) like concat('%', #{uid}, '%')
and username like concat('%', #{username}, '%')
and email like concat('%', #{email}, '%')
and authority like concat('%', #{authority}, '%')
and cno like concat('%', #{cno}, '%')
and cname like concat('%', #{cname}, '%')
and csex like concat('%', #{csex}, '%')
and cage like concat('%', #{cage}, '%')
and caddress like concat('%', #{caddress}, '%')
and cphone like concat('%', #{cphone}, '%')
and cdate between #{startDate} and #{endDate}
and cremark like concat('%', #{cremark}, '%')
and balance like concat('%', #{balance}, '%')
SELECT user.uid, username, authority, cno, email, cname, csex, cage, caddress, cphone, cdate, cremark, balance FROM user, client WHERE user.uid = #{uid} and user.uid = client.uid
mapper.update: UPDATE client SET cno=#{cno}, cname=#{cname}, csex=#{csex}, cage=#{cage}, caddress=#{caddress}, cphone=#{cphone}, cremark=#{cremark}, cdate=#{cdate}, balance=#{balance} WHERE uid = #{uid}
